STYP.description: Structure Type (STYP). Single project-wide record (key is always 1) defining the analysis structure type, mass control, gravity, initial temperature, and section alignment options.
Structure type code. 3-D: 0, X-Z Plane: 1, Y-Z Plane: 2, X-Y Plane: 3, Constraint RZ (X-Y Plane): 4.

MASS.description: Mass type code. Lumped Mass: 1, Consistent Mass: 2.

bMASSOFFSET.description: [MASS=1] Consider off-diagonal/offset masses (applies to Lumped Mass).

bROTRIGID.description: [MASS=1] Consider rotational rigid body mode for modal participation factor (applies to Lumped Mass).

bSELFWEIGHT.description: [MASS=1] Convert self-weight into masses (applies to Lumped Mass).

SMASS.description: [bSELFWEIGHT=true] Structure mass conversion type. Convert to X, Y, Z: 1, Convert to X, Y: 2, Convert to Z: 3.
